# IT Test

> Free IT knowledge tests: programming, networking, cybersecurity and IT fundamentals.

- Site: https://it-tests.vercel.app/
- Repo: https://github.com/andresWeitzel/WebSite_Test_IT
- Language: Spanish (es-AR)
- License: Open source

## Pages

- Home: https://it-tests.vercel.app/
- Programming tests: https://it-tests.vercel.app/html/testProgramacion.html
- Networks & Infrastructure tests: https://it-tests.vercel.app/html/testRedes.html
- Cybersecurity tests: https://it-tests.vercel.app/html/testSeguridadInformatica.html
- IT Fundamentals tests: https://it-tests.vercel.app/html/testFundamentosIT.html
- Study material: https://it-tests.vercel.app/html/materialEstudio.html
- News / calendar: https://it-tests.vercel.app/html/novedades.html

## Features

- 4 IT areas, 3 levels each, 4 modalities per level (quick, classic, extended, practical reading)
- Unlimited attempts with local score tracking
- Free study material and practice path
